title: Grok vs ChatGPT 2026: Which AI Chatbot Actually Wins?
summary: Grok vs ChatGPT 2026: honest comparison of pricing, capabilities, coding performance, and real-time data. We tested both — here's what the data shows.
body_markdown: For API usage, yes — Grok is substantially cheaper. Grok charges $2 per million input tokens versus ChatGPT's $5, and $6 versus $30 per million output tokens. For consumer subscriptions, Grok's mid-tier (SuperGrok, $30/month) is actually $10 more expensive than ChatGPT Plus ($20/month) — and delivers fewer features. ChatGPT wins on value at the consumer tier; Grok wins on value at the API tier.
